<style id="sodc-home-css">
/* Smile On homepage styles. Based on the Al Satwa location page system (WPCode snippet 6838), scoped to this page via this inline style block. Brand: teal #2D9CA9 -> violet #6656C4 */
body{--sodc-teal:#2D9CA9;--sodc-violet:#6656C4;--sodc-ink:#1d2733;--sodc-muted:#55606d;--sodc-line:#e7ecf1}
body .sodc-sat-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1fafb 0%,#f4f2fd 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
body .sodc-sat-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:560px;height:560px;right:-180px;top:-200px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(102,86,196,.16),rgba(102,86,196,0) 70%);pointer-events:none}
body .sodc-sat-hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:380px;height:380px;left:-160px;bottom:-200px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(45,156,169,.16),rgba(45,156,169,0) 70%);pointer-events:none}
body .sodc-pill p{display:inline-block;margin:0;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d6eef0;color:var(--sodc-teal);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(45,156,169,.10)}
body .sodc-h1 .elementor-heading-title{font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,56px);line-height:1.08;font-weight:700;color:var(--sodc-ink);letter-spacing:-.02em}
body .sodc-lead p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--sodc-muted);max-width:580px;margin:0}
body .sodc-trust .elementor-icon-list-text{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--sodc-ink)}
body .sodc-btn-grad .elementor-button,body .sodc-btn-ghost .elementor-button,body .sodc-btn-white .elementor-button,body .sodc-btn-outline-white .elementor-button{font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:16px;border-radius:32px;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,background .2s ease,color .2s ease}
body .sodc-btn-grad .elementor-button{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2D9CA9 0%,#6656C4 100%);color:#fff;padding:15px 30px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(102,86,196,.24)}
body .sodc-btn-grad .elementor-button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(102,86,196,.32);color:#fff}
body .sodc-btn-ghost .elementor-button{background:#fff;color:var(--sodc-teal);border:2px solid var(--sodc-teal);padding:13px 28px}
body .sodc-btn-ghost .elementor-button:hover{background:var(--sodc-teal);color:#fff}
body .sodc-btn-white .elementor-button{background:#fff;color:var(--sodc-violet);padding:15px 30px;font-weight:600}
body .sodc-btn-white .elementor-button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
body .sodc-btn-outline-white .elementor-button{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);padding:13px 26px}
body .sodc-btn-outline-white .elementor-button:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--sodc-teal)}
body .sodc-collage-wrap{position:relative}
body .sodc-collage{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;padding-bottom:28px}
body .sodc-collage>.elementor-widget-image:nth-child(even){transform:translateY(28px)}
body .sodc-collage img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(29,39,51,.14)}
body .sodc-float-card{position:absolute;left:-28px;bottom:6px;z-index:3;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 18px;box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(29,39,51,.18);max-width:250px;border-left:4px solid var(--sodc-violet)}
body .sodc-float-card p{margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--sodc-muted)}
body .sodc-float-card strong{color:var(--sodc-ink);font-size:15px}
body .sodc-stats{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2D9CA9 0%,#6656C4 100%)}
body .sodc-stats>.e-con-inner>.elementor-widget-counter,body .sodc-stats>.elementor-widget-counter{flex:1 1 180px}
body .sodc-stats .elementor-counter-number-wrapper{font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:44px;line-height:1.1}
body .sodc-stats .elementor-counter-title{font-size:15px;opacity:.92}
body .sodc-h2 .elementor-heading-title{font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(28px,3.2vw,38px);line-height:1.2;font-weight:700;color:var(--sodc-ink);letter-spacing:-.01em}
body .sodc-sub p{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;color:var(--sodc-muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.6}
body .sodc-tint{background:#f6f8fb}
body .sodc-grid{display:grid!important;gap:20px;margin-top:12px}
body .sodc-grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
body .sodc-grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
@media (max-width:1024px){body .sodc-grid-4,body .sodc-grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (max-width:600px){body .sodc-grid-4,body .sodc-grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}body .sodc-docs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
body .sodc-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--sodc-line);border-radius:18px;padding:26px 24px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(29,39,51,.05);transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
body .sodc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(45,156,169,.16)}
body .sodc-card .elementor-icon-box-title{font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-size:19px;font-weight:600;color:var(--sodc-ink);margin-bottom:6px}
body .sodc-card .elementor-icon-box-description{color:var(--sodc-muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
body .sodc-card .elementor-icon{font-size:22px}
body .sodc-tile{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--sodc-line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease,border-color .25s ease}
body .sodc-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--sodc-teal);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(45,156,169,.14)}
body .sodc-tile .elementor-icon{font-size:26px}
body .sodc-tile .elementor-icon-box-title,body .sodc-tile .elementor-icon-box-title a{font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;color:var(--sodc-ink)}
body .sodc-tile .elementor-icon-box-description{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--sodc-muted)}
body .sodc-doc .elementor-image-box-wrapper{text-align:left}
body .sodc-doc .elementor-image-box-img{width:100%!important;margin:0 0 14px!important;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px}
body .sodc-doc img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;border-radius:18px;transition:transform .4s ease}
body .sodc-doc:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
body .sodc-doc .elementor-image-box-title,body .sodc-doc .elementor-image-box-title a{font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;color:var(--sodc-ink);margin-bottom:2px}
body .sodc-doc .elementor-image-box-description{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--sodc-teal);font-weight:500}
body .sodc-docs{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:18px}
@media (max-width:1024px){body .sodc-docs{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important}}
@media (max-width:600px){body .sodc-docs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:14px}}
body .sodc-visit h3.elementor-heading-title{font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:var(--sodc-ink)}
body .sodc-visit p{color:var(--sodc-muted);line-height:1.6;margin:0}
body .sodc-visit a{color:var(--sodc-violet)}
body .sodc-mapframe{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(29,39,51,.12)}
body .sodc-mapframe iframe{display:block}
@media (max-width:767px){body .sodc-mapframe iframe{height:300px}}
body .sodc-note{background:#fff;border-left:4px solid var(--sodc-violet);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 22px;margin-top:12px}
body .sodc-note p{margin:0;color:var(--sodc-muted);line-height:1.6}
body .sodc-faq .elementor-toggle{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
body .sodc-faq .elementor-toggle-item{border:1px solid var(--sodc-line);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
body .sodc-faq .elementor-tab-title{border:0!important;padding:18px 22px!important;font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;color:var(--sodc-ink)}
body .sodc-faq .elementor-tab-title a,body .sodc-faq .elementor-toggle-title{color:var(--sodc-ink)}
body .sodc-faq .elementor-tab-title.elementor-active a,body .sodc-faq .elementor-tab-title.elementor-active .elementor-toggle-title{color:var(--sodc-violet)}
body .sodc-faq .elementor-toggle-icon{color:var(--sodc-teal)}
body .sodc-faq .elementor-tab-content{border:0!important;padding:0 22px 18px!important;color:var(--sodc-muted);line-height:1.65}
body .sodc-faq .elementor-tab-content a{color:var(--sodc-violet)}
body .sodc-cta{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#2D9CA9 0%,#6656C4 100%);border-radius:28px;max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto 72px}
body .sodc-cta .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff;font-family:Rubik,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,36px);font-weight:700}
body .sodc-cta p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);font-size:17px;margin:0}
@media (max-width:767px){
body .sodc-float-card{position:relative;left:auto;bottom:auto;margin-top:12px;max-width:none}
body .sodc-stats .elementor-counter-number-wrapper{font-size:36px}
body .sodc-cta{border-radius:20px;width:auto!important;max-width:calc(100% - 32px)!important;margin:0 16px 48px!important}
}

/* Homepage additions */
body .sodc-css{display:none!important}
body .sodc-kicker p{display:inline-block;margin:0;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:#EEEBFA;color:#6656C4;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
body .sodc-kicker{margin-bottom:-6px}
body .sodc-offer{border-top:4px solid var(--sodc-violet)}
body .sodc-offer .elementor-icon-box-title{font-size:20px}
body .sodc-offer-hot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6656C4 0%,#4f43a8 100%);border-color:transparent;border-top-color:#f5a623}
body .sodc-offer-hot .elementor-icon-box-title,body .sodc-offer-hot .elementor-icon-box-description{color:#fff!important}
body .sodc-offer-hot .elementor-icon{background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18)!important;color:#fff!important;fill:#fff!important}
body .sodc-small p{font-size:14px}
body .sodc-reviews,body .wpr-grid{max-width:1140px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;width:100%}
body .sodc-form{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--sodc-line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px}
body .sodc-tile .elementor-icon-box-title,body .sodc-tile .elementor-icon-box-title a{font-size:16px}
@media (max-width:600px){body .sodc-tile{padding:16px}}

</style>

settings.editor: From Invisalign and dental implants to teeth whitening and root canal care, we correct, repair and restore healthier smiles. Every treatment is carried out by a dentist who specialises in it, in one comfortable clinic on 2nd December Street. Open every day, 9am to 9pm.

settings.editor:
Meet your specialists
Braces, root canals, implants, gums and kids, all in one clinic
Whatever your smile needs, there's a specialist for it under one roof. Tap a treatment to see how it works and who carries it out.

settings.description_text: Metal, ceramic, Damon and lingual braces with a specialist orthodontist.
Clear aligners for teens and adults from a certified Invisalign provider.
Self-ligating braces with fewer adjustments.
Replace missing teeth, from a single implant to All-on-4.
Leave with a temporary tooth on the day, when the implant is stable.
Save an infected tooth with a specialist endodontist.
Smile makeovers planned around your face and your bite.
In-clinic and Zoom whitening for a brighter smile.
Natural-looking veneers that reshape and brighten.
Restore broken or missing teeth with lasting results.
Periodontist-led care for bleeding or receding gums.
Gentle visits with a specialist pediatric dentist.
A full exam, with X-rays only when they're needed.
Scaling and polishing from AED 150.
A complete plan to restore comfort, function and looks.
Handled by our oral and maxillofacial surgeon.
Includes an X-ray and scaling for children. Ideal for a first visit.
A professional clean to remove tartar and surface stains.
Clean and brighten your smile in one visit.

settings.editor: Offers are subject to availability and a dentist's assessment.

settings.title: Why Patients Across Dubai Choose Smile On

settings.editor: Patient comfort and quality care come first. We combine experienced specialists with modern dental technology for an accurate diagnosis, safe procedures and reliable results.

settings.description_text: An orthodontist, endodontist, oral surgeon, prosthodontist, periodontist and pediatric dentist all work here. No referral across town.
A 5.0 rating on Google from 333 reviews by patients across Dubai.
Severe pain, a broken tooth or swelling? We keep slots open so you can usually be seen the day you call.
Digital X-rays and modern equipment for an accurate diagnosis, with your options and costs explained first.
On 2nd December Street, easy to reach from Jumeirah, Bur Dubai, Karama and across Dubai.
Established in 2021 by Dr. Arun Devarajan and Dr. Jeffrey Manuel, with five years of trusted dental care in Dubai.

settings.editor: Six specialists work alongside our general dentists, so even complex cases are planned and treated in the same building.

settings.title: Your First Visit, Step by Step

settings.description_text: Book online, call or send a WhatsApp message. If you're in pain, tell us and we'll look for the earliest slot.
We listen first, then check your teeth and gums. X-rays are taken only when they're needed for a diagnosis.
You hear what we found, your options and what each one costs, with no pressure to decide on the day.
When you're ready, the specialist for your treatment takes over, in the same clinic.

settings.editor: Insurance and payment. We work with a range of insurance providers and offer flexible payment options for treatment your plan doesn't cover. Send us your insurance details when you book and we'll confirm your cover before your visit.

tabs.tab_title: What dental services does Smile On Dental Clinic offer?
tabs.tab_content: We offer a full range of dental care under one roof, including general and preventive dentistry, cosmetic treatments like teeth whitening and veneers, orthodontics including Invisalign and braces, dental implants, root canal treatment, gum treatments and pediatric dentistry for children. See all dental services.

tabs.tab_title: Where is Smile On Dental Clinic located?
tabs.tab_content: Our clinic is in Al Satwa, Dubai, at Unit 213, AMKM Investment Building, 2nd December Street. We're easy to reach from Jumeirah, Bur Dubai and other nearby areas.
We're open every day of the week, from 9am to 9pm.

tabs.tab_title: Do you accept insurance or offer payment plans?
tabs.tab_content: We work with a range of insurance providers and also offer flexible payment options for treatments not covered by insurance. Contact our team before your visit and we'll confirm your coverage.

tabs.tab_title: Can I get a same-day emergency dental appointment?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We keep slots open for urgent dental concerns such as severe pain, broken teeth or swelling, so you can usually be seen the same day you call +971 55 896 1826.
Yes. Our specialist pediatric dentist, Dr. Minu Mumtaz O.V., sees babies, children and teens. Ask about our free pediatric consultation.

tabs.tab_title: How do I book an appointment?
tabs.tab_content: Call us directly at +971 55 896 1826 or book online. Our team will confirm your appointment time and send you a reminder before your visit.

tabs.tab_title: What languages do your doctors speak?
tabs.tab_content: Our team is multilingual and comfortable treating patients in English along with several other languages. Let our front desk know your preference when you book and we'll do our best to accommodate you.

settings.title: Ready for a Healthier, Brighter Smile?
